The '''Tredway mine''' was located on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[24 Tredway]] in the [[Sil'Lume asteroid belt]]. Owned by the [[Tredway family]], it was the most profitable [[Mining/Legends|mine]] in the belt until its destruction by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="JH">''[[Jedi's Honor]]''</ref>
